selector_intent: Inject an unexplained change to a result-determining input, replay the bound result, and assert failure if validation accepts it as current or emits an unmarked valid-looking result.
Select the adversarial dependency fixture that would otherwise yield success; execute the semantic gate and require a non-success verdict identifying the dependency violation.
Remove provenance metadata from one named seed occurrence in the evaluation-seed manifest fixture and require RMAP-S2 validation failure.
Invoke the validator with support-policy evaluation disabled or omitted; require failure proving the independent check is mandatory.
Select a seed manifest fixture in which one of the three named occurrences omits applicability; validation must fail with the missing occurrence identified.
Use the existing coverage-predicate negative cases that omit, duplicate, or misbind a required assertion edge and require exact-cover validation to reject them.
向 exact-cover negative validator 提供一个缺少 command-to-Atomic-Obligation 反向覆盖的关系。
Target a successful replay receipt lacking its independent Consumer-verification binding and require the downstream replay assertion to fail.
Configure Stable and Candidate to reference the same fixture or state namespace and run the distinction validator; require failure identifying the collision.
Run the existing timeout selector with a process that exceeds its descriptor timeout and assert zero cases plus unsuccessful timeout-no-observation classification.
Run the success-decision validator with one required identity or execution fact omitted, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable; it must reject success.
Remove one applicable transition result for a non-empty manifest entry and run reconciliation; require failure identifying the missing transition.
Run the process-executor timeout test with a blocking process fixture; it must fail when no finite timeout stops the process.
Select an artifact whose machine-readable authorization_set contains one or more entries and assert validation failure.
Modify one byte in an existing tracked file before running the repair comparison.
Exercise a declared matrix case without an execution attestation and require aggregate invalidation.
Run the RMAP-S2 aggregate validator against the existing evaluation artifact set with its required matrix receipt removed from the selector fixture.
Run the detached Probe with a bound always-success false-negative selector and require semantic Probe evaluation to emit a failed outcome.
以缺失独立进程启动、输入绑定或输出绑定的 detached positive Probe 运行配置执行。
Run the negative Probe only in the parent process and verify detached-process assertion fails.
Select the aggregate-evaluation path with stale matrix evidence and assert that validity or acceptance is incorrectly retained.
Select the reused-evidence fixture and evaluate it; the evaluator must deterministically return non-success.
Supply a repository-relative path containing traversal outside the permitted scope; the boundary selector must fail if the path is accepted or used.
Select the targeted real-Consumer execution test or probe and fail when any applicable Consumer lacks a production call-surface invocation or successful enable evidence.
Exercise the existing case-evidence mutation/continuity selector with mismatched or stale case evidence and require validation to reject it before it can prove a result.
Select a graph fixture with a one-way Atomic Obligation-to-witness link or an orphan witness; exact-cover validation must fail.
Run the seed-manifest validator against a fixture with a duplicate or missing named seed; it must fail the exact-once cardinality and metadata check.
Mutate, remove, rename, relocate, or alter bytes of a frozen historical record and verify the historical-record manifest guard fails.
Use the existing skill replay lifecycle test selector with a trace missing real re-enable or containing simulated-only re-enable; integration validation must fail.
Run the Matrix evaluator with one case missing one subject execution; aggregate evaluation must return non-success.
使用缺少 source identity 或 source SHA-256 与当前字节不一致的 receipt，source-traceability 测试必须拒绝。
Target the Windows replay-support assertion while the receipt lacks the supported Windows platform declaration.
Execute the unsupported-target case in the repository-owned skill package replay test and require the replay command's nonzero rejection.
Run route resolution with the supported VDD route removed or unregistered; the check must fail because the route is unavailable.
Select a graph where an Atomic Obligation points to a selector but reverse selector coverage is absent.
Execute the repository-owned replay selector from a fresh checkout fixture with a missing local-state dependency or result-determining snapshot drift and require a failed replay.
Alter one reconstructed Exact Cover relation or introduce an orphan node.
Remove or bypass validator-source inspection while leaving other validator checks enabled.
Use the stale validation-result fixture through the Toolchain evaluation selector; fail the guard if its stale binding can yield success.
Construct an otherwise successful replay result without an independent Probe verification record and assert that the replay result is rejected.
Remove a required witness or introduce an orphan atomic obligation in the validation fixture; exact-cover validation must report incomplete coverage.
Skip disable invocation and verify successful Consumer evidence is absent.
Evaluate matrix inputs with copied evidence assigned to distinct matrix cases and assert that aggregate acceptance fails.
Use the existing read-only target validator selector with a required/supplied identity mismatch; validation must fail closed before dispatch.
Remove pre/post identity evidence and verify acceptance fails.
Execute an aggregate with a deliberately small output budget and unbounded producer; the guard must fail if output exceeds the configured limit or no terminal state is reached.
Replace one required identity or evidence binding in the fresh replay receipt.
Execute the illegal-target negative probe; the validator must observe rejection and fail if the operation proceeds or substitutes a target.
现有 replay unit test 向共享入口传入不存在 target，并观察 fail-closed 拒绝。

Run the isolated rollback fixture through the Consumer lifecycle with rejection-only or configuration-only rollback substituted; the runtime observation must fail because no real Prior Route call restores the recorded identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.
Replay evidence validation against altered effective content or a mismatched digest; validator must reject the successful evidence.
Force aggregate timeout or conflicting terminal transitions and verify the execution is rejected unless one deterministic unsuccessful terminal state is recorded.
The compatibility assertion must fail if a valid-target result is accepted without the detached negative probe rejecting an always-success validator for an invalid target.
Inject an infrastructure-failed matrix execution result into aggregate evaluation and require invalid non-accepted output.
Exercise current_snapshot with a Windows user-profile path as a declared root and require rejection.
Provide a verdict with assistant prose but omit or invalidate source identity or real execution evidence; validator must reject acceptance.
Select a Matrix Case fixture with its Stable or Candidate subject record omitted; validation must fail for incomplete subject coverage.
Run the evaluation-seed validation selector after removing missing_labels from one named occurrence and require a deterministic validation failure.
Select a replay-result fixture whose current snapshot manifest omits a required file or binding identity; the replay validator must reject the result as incomplete.
Execute the success evaluator against a deliberately skipped-Consumer fixture and assert a non-success verdict containing the skipped-Consumer diagnostic.
Remove or point a declared supported Acceptance package route at an unavailable target and verify route validation fails.
Exercise a produced replay verdict with a missing or unbound real-execution trace and require fail-closed rejection.
Use a fixture whose inspected path or bytes differ from the intended target identity; independent verification must fail closed.
使新鲜检出重放的 semantic verdict 与同一固定输入的基线 verdict 不同。
Delete the independent verification record while leaving replay success true and verify acceptance fails.
Return success while omitting or falsifying the independent dependency-verification record and verify acceptance fails.
Exercise an adversarial validator matrix case and require the success evaluator to reject its success classification.
Select a negative validator path that substitutes a mock, stub, simulated dispatch, or direct state mutation for the Consumer real call surface, and fail when that substitution is accepted.
使新鲜检出重放的 coverage result 与同一固定输入的基线结果不同。
Present an unexecuted-case fixture to the success evaluator; the selector must produce a non-success verdict, and a green success verdict is a failure.
向已存在 evidence 路径写入不同字节或请求边界外 evidence 写入，runtime-evidence 测试必须拒绝。
Omit one result-determining input from the Current Snapshot manifest.
Remove one required Matrix Case subject execution from the evaluation input and run the aggregate evaluator; it must return a failed aggregate with the missing execution identified.
Execute a worker that exceeds its configured time or output budget and verify the harness observes deterministic unsuccessful termination with an exhaustion reason.
Run exact-cover orphan validation with at least one uncovered atomic obligation; validation must fail.
Run the detached Probe against an infrastructure-failure false-negative fixture and assert that the evaluator returns a failed Probe outcome with the infrastructure failure classification.
以现有负例移除 assertion 的反向 Atomic Obligation 绑定，验证器必须以 wrong_binding 阻断。
Remove an input or output binding and verify evaluation fails.
Remove or invalidate the independent target-verification record from a successful Replay Result; acceptance must fail.
Select a validator result containing source, content, and compatibility checks but no dedicated candidate-external-trust assertion; validation must fail for omitted independent trust verification.
Delete both the counterexample and explicit-absence fields for one named seed while retaining the occurrence entry.
Run the existing exact-cover negative validator with its isolated reverse-mapping orphan fixture and require its deliberate nonzero outcome.
Run membership validation with a fixture or working-tree state that adds, removes, renames, or alters a tracked path; validation must reject success.
Bind an adversarial target case that exits successfully where a non-success result is required and require replay-matrix evaluation to fail.
Target the receipt-structure assertion after removing the explicit platform-behavior declaration.
Run the existing wrong-target mutation selector that supplies a descriptor whose frozen target reference cannot be bound, then assert its observation is non-admissible.
Omit or mutate Validator Capability verification while leaving the replay result successful; validation must reject the result.
Run the append-only evidence validator against a fixture that attempts overwrite or deletion of an existing repair record; it must fail on mutation.
Exercise a matrix fixture whose component bindings alias one mutable evidence identity and require the isolation guard to reject it.
Substitute or alter the target package after identity verification; the acceptance path must reject the mismatched identity.
Invoke replay-matrix with an isolated matrix fixture whose evidence label is deliberately mismatched from its bound case category; fail the guard if the aggregate does not reject that evidence.
Exercise rollback with a non-empty Consumer Manifest entry whose observed behavior differs from the Prior Behavior Baseline; the verification must fail and identify that entry.
Supply a before/after snapshot pair containing a renamed, relocated, or rewritten repository-relative path and require the bounded worker delta guard to reject it.
Remove the reverse edge from one runtime-evidence node while retaining its forward Atomic Obligation edge.
Cause fresh replay to emit a terminal verdict different from the pinned result.
Run the existing invalid-package matrix case against an always-successful validator and require replay-matrix to reject its success.
Run the matrix receipt validator with a missing or mismatched Matrix Case or executed-subject identity and require rejection.
Provide a case whose authority identifier differs from the current authority; success evaluation must return non-success.
Use the existing authorization negative validator with historical evidence as the sole claimed authority; authorization must be rejected.
Use a matrix execution manifest with a duplicate input identity or an omitted case execution; the structural matrix validator must fail.
Provide two Matrix Case records referencing the same evidence identity and run aggregate validation; the validator must mark the aggregate invalid and deny acceptance.
Run the dedicated closure validator against a graph with a missing reachable dependency; it must fail on the closure defect.
Select execution evidence with missing or mismatched Matrix Case/subject attribution; validation must fail traceability checking.
Use a Consumer lifecycle trace whose post-re-enable route identity, verdict, or diagnostics differ from its captured baseline and require lifecycle validation to fail.
Run the process-executor output-limit test with an over-limit output fixture; it must fail when no finite output bound is enforced.
Mutate a bound Current Snapshot member and attempt semantic reproduction.
Cause fresh replay diagnostics to differ from the pinned categories.
Run the RMAP-S2 seed-validation selector with one named occurrence assigned an unapproved or baseline classification; validation must reject that manifest.
Select a replay result whose success path omits or bypasses independent snapshot verification and assert rejection.
Remove or omit a required VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing caller from the reconciled Consumer Manifest.
Change the native command executable or argument vector and verify identity comparison fails.
Select a successful Replay Result fixture whose output is present but whose verification record omits the independent output check; the validator must fail the acceptance oracle.
Exercise the deterministic-finalization authorization boundary and require non-finalization artifacts to retain an empty authorization set.
Modify the test validator after capability digest creation and require the capability-validation invocation to fail for validator identity drift.
Select a case fixture whose Stable or Candidate subject identity hash differs between execution start and completion; validation must fail immutability enforcement.
Substitute a bound identity before fresh replay.
Remove or invalidate the independent command-verification record from a successful Replay Result; acceptance must fail.
Run package validation against a fixture whose declared package identity conflicts with the requested package and assert that acceptance is impossible.
Invoke the aggregate evaluator with a workload that exceeds its configured finite time budget and assert deterministic unsuccessful termination.
Route disable through a mock or simulated Consumer and verify real-call-surface assertion fails.
Alter one non-authority binding identity and verify the independent verifier rejects the result.
